mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 47 degrees with dense drizzle at Badger Prairie County Park. It is a new moon, and if you look south over Belleville at 5:43 PM, you can catch the space station as it travels toward Fitchburg for 3 minutes.

City news today includes the opening of candidate registration for the 2027 Spring Election, with paperwork due to the City Clerk by January 5, plus updates on the Military Ridge State Trail paving project and Mark Drive reconstruction.

There is plenty to do with live music at Paddy Mac's today, yoga at Insight Wellness today, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee today, followed by trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after locating him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
